abstract: Production skill for cost-efficient Firecrawl use. Routes each job to the cheapest endpoint, bans /agent, /extract and premium hosts, prices requests offline with a guard script before they are sent, and documents live-measured billing from 2026-10-18: billed error pages, free failures, cache hits that still cost a credit, per-page PDF parsing, LLM-format surcharges, search rounding, and a crawl of a one-page site that billed 809 query-string variants.
